name: comsol_mcp
description: COMSOL execution MCP for PFR: open model, set params, run pipeline, export canonical outputs

tools.name: comsol.open_or_create_model
tools.description: Open an existing .mph model or copy a template into the run directory

tools.name: comsol.apply_inputs
tools.description: Apply parameters from results/runs/<run_id>/inputs/*.yaml to the COMSOL model

tools.name: comsol.build_geometry
tools.description: Rebuild geometry (if template uses parametric geometry)

tools.name: comsol.mesh
tools.description: Generate mesh (optionally using a named mesh sequence)

tools.name: comsol.run_pipeline
tools.description: Run the standard A→B→C→D pipeline for PFR

tools.name: comsol.run_study
tools.description: Run a specific COMSOL study ID (advanced)

tools.name: comsol.export_fields
tools.description: Export fields to outputs/fields.h5 (or intermediate formats), per PFR_Data_Schema

tools.name: comsol.render_png
tools.description: Render a sanity-check PNG plot into plots/ (e.g., chi map, DeltaB map)

tools.name: comsol.close_model
tools.description: Close the model and release resources
